proof_summary: Rewrite the Gamma quotient using double factorials and split according to the parity of the index, then strip all factors divisible by $p$ from the resulting factorial and double-factorial ratios.  Partitioning the remaining factors into blocks modulo $q=p^r$, a degree-two expansion of $\prod_u(1+qj/u)$ and vanishing inverse-unit sums make full blocks invariant modulo $q^3$ (with paired half-block identities supplying the odd-case powers of $2$), after which the coprime denominator cancels.
